BACKEND / DEVOPS / AIAUG 2026 — PRESENT

AI DevOps
Incident Assistant

A FastAPI backend that turns Docker and CI deployment failures into structured, AI-powered diagnostics using Gemini.

  • Root cause, suggested fix, and confidence in consistent JSON.
  • Searchable incident history with PostgreSQL and SQLAlchemy.
  • Automated Docker builds and GHCR publishing via GitHub Actions.
React.jsPythonFastAPIPostgreSQLDockerGemini API

How it works
Deployment failure → container logs → Gemini response_schema → structured diagnostics → PostgreSQL incident history → REST query endpoint.

GitHub Actions builds and pushes container images to GHCR on each push.

CLOUD / AUTOMATIONJUL 2025

Multi-Environment
AWS Infrastructure

Repeatable AWS infrastructure across development, staging, and production, provisioned through reusable Terraform modules.

  • Environment-specific EC2 and S3 provisioning.
  • S3 remote state with DynamoDB locking for concurrent runs.
  • GitLab CI/CD pipelines automate init, plan, and apply.
TerraformAWSGitLab CI/CDGit

How it works
Git push → GitLab CI/CD → Terraform init → plan → apply → environment-specific EC2 and S3 resources in ap-south-1.

Reusable modules share infrastructure definitions. S3 stores remote state and DynamoDB locking coordinates concurrent Terraform runs.

ASK BETTER QUESTIONS.

What gets lost
when AI context
gets smaller?

“Numbers Don’t Survive Compression”

An empirical study of answer-type vulnerability to extractive context compression in LLMs. I explored how numerical answers and named entities respond differently when context is compressed.
